answer: The shale index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1458 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the marble. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the ripple queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The deposit is 37 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
